description: Angular component for configuring time interval options, including form controls, interval management, and user interactions.

classes.name: IntervalOptionsConfigPanelComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing time interval configuration panel, including form setup, interval selection, and user actions.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up interval options based on type, and constructs the form controls.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Collects user-selected intervals and configuration, then triggers the onClose callback with the data.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Calls onClose with null to cancel the operation.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all interval controls to enabled state with default configuration.

methods.name: getQuickIntervals
methods.description: Returns a filtered list of quick time intervals based on the time window type.

methods.name: getIntervalMs
methods.description: Converts interval to milliseconds, considering the interval type.

methods.name: trackByElement
methods.description: Track function for Angular list rendering.

methods.name: minAggInterval
methods.description: Returns minimum allowed aggregation interval for a given interval.

methods.name: maxAggInterval
methods.description: Returns maximum allowed aggregation interval for a given interval.

methods.name: get intervalsFormArray
methods.description: Getter for the form array of interval controls.

methods.name: getIndeterminate
methods.description: Determines if the selection is partial (some enabled, some disabled).

methods.name: enableDisableIntervals
methods.description: Enables or disables all interval controls based on the parameter.

methods.name: getChecked
methods.description: Checks if all intervals are enabled.
